name: High School Internship
org: San Diego Natural History Museum (The Nat)
what_you_do: Intern in a museum science lab for school credit. Labs include birds and mammals, plants, bugs, reptiles and fossils.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 and at least a junior. You must be in an internship class at your school and get course credit. For a science internship, you need one general biology course first.
pay_detail: School course credit. Interns are not employees.
duration: You and your school set the dates and hours. Weekdays only.
deadline_text: The form lists no deadline as of Nov 2, 2026. You give your own dates. Spots are limited.
how_to_apply: Fill out the internship form online. Give your school, your hours, why you want to intern, and your past work. List two teachers as references. The museum may then ask you to interview.
notes: Filling out the form does not promise you a spot. The science departments are closed on weekends. Without a school internship class, you must be 18 to help in these departments. Questions: 619-232-3821.
